instruction: Look at freecad_task-14_input.step in FreeCAD. Turn the two-post base into a reinforced carry handle. Fuse a horizontal cylindrical crossbar between the post tops: axis along X from X=35 to X=125, diameter 16 mm, center at Y=25 mm and Z=50 mm. Add four exact triangular web plates, each 5 mm thick along Y: two front webs span Y=10 to 15 mm and two rear webs span Y=35 to 40 mm. The left front and left rear webs use XZ triangle vertices (35,10), (35,38), and (62,50); the right front and right rear webs use XZ triangle vertices (125,10), (125,38), and (98,50). Cut a horizontal through hole of diameter 9 mm through each vertical post along Y, centered at X=35 and X=125, Y=25, Z=38. Cut four vertical base mounting holes of diameter 7 mm at X=20,60,100,140 mm on Y=25 mm. Export the fused handle as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-14_output.step. Work only in the FreeCAD GUI; external script files are prohibited.
